title: Jacobikerk — Le Guess Who?
excerpt: A site-specific light intervention for Le Guess Who? festival in the historic Jacobikerk, Utrecht.
description:
For Le Guess Who? 2022, Uncloud and the LiGHT-UP Collective turned the historic Jacobikerk in Utrecht into an immersive projected space for the festival's concert programme — the setting for performances by Mabe Fratti, Hatis Noit and Hinako Omori.
> Working with the church's gothic architecture, the design wrapped the nave and its chandeliers in slow, shifting light — turning the building itself into an instrument of atmosphere.
credits: An immersive projected space by Uncloud & LiGHT-UP Collective, Le Guess Who? 2022, Jacobikerk, Utrecht. Photography: Moíses Méndez.
